caption: the pillow is the top-most pillow on the bed. there are multiple pillows under the pillow. the pillow is on top of the bed sheets. the pillow is a cream color (white-light yellow). there is a red blanket in front of the pillow.

the window is located between two beds. the detail and the panes of the both sides of the window appear to be different.  the window has a large, brown window ledge.  on the ledge, there is a box with multiple rubix cubes.
the closet is not very deep.  there are brown shelves to the right/front of the closet. there is a plant on the top shelf.  there are multiple towels hanging inside the closet.
the small desk is located between two beds. the desk is made from wood and is the color brown. on top of the desk, there is a laptop and headphones.  the desk is in front of the window.
the shelf is brown and made from wood. there are three levels to the brown shelf. there is a plant on the top shelf. there are candles on the shelf. the shelf is in front of the closet.
